questions.prediction: The parent is expected to throw on offset normalization beyond LocalDate’s bounds. On the merge let D = LocalDate.MAX.toEpochDay() − LocalDate.MIN.toEpochDay() + 1. Expect D and −D days, and D/7 and −(D/7) whole weeks.

questions.refutation: An exception on the merge, loss of the extra complete day, or disagreement between days and weeks.
